_provenance.schema_fidelity: FRED represents an unavailable value with the string '.' — the same marker ALFRED's Download Data Help documents for an undefined real-time period end ('These missing values are represented as a "." in the text format'). The '.' row below is that marker.
_provenance.scenario: Three observation dates at one vintage: a value, an explicit missing marker, and a genuine zero. The zero is the point of the fixture as much as the marker is — a parser that turns '.' into 0 becomes indistinguishable from one reading a real zero, and both would then be averaged into features as if they were measurements.
